# infoblox_dtc_topology (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox DtcTopology from both the NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific DTC Topology using filters
data "infoblox_dtc_topology" "get_dtc_topology_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "example-topology-basic"
  }
}

// Retrieve specific DTC Topologies using Extensible Attributes
data "infoblox_dtc_topology" "get_dtc_topology_using_extensible_attributes" {
  ext_attr_filters = {
    Site = "us-east-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all DTC Topologies
data "infoblox_dtc_topology" "get_all_dtc_topologies" {}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific DTC Topology using filters
data "infoblox_dtc_topology" "get_dtc_topology_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "example-topology-basic"
  }
}

// Retrieve specific DTC Topologies using Tag Filters
data "infoblox_dtc_topology" "get_dtc_topology_using_tag_filters" {
  tag_filters = {
    Site = "us-east-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all DTC Topologies
data "infoblox_dtc_topology" "get_all_dtc_topologies" {}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to return a more specific list of results by filtering on extensible attributes. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `limit` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for UDDI backend.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. Only applicable for UDDI backend.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Optional. Comment for __Topology__.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Optional. Flag which enables/disables __Topology__.  Defaults to _false_.
- `name` (String) Display name of __Topology__.
- `sources` (Attributes List) Required. List of __TopologySource__ objects with unique names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--sources))
- `tags` (Map of String) Optional. The tags for __Topology__ in JSON format.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.sources`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Required. Display name of __TopologySource__.
- `source` (String) Type of source.  Allowed values: - subnet - tag_rule  Required.
- `subnets` (List of String) Optional. List of subnets in CIDR format.  Must be set if _source_ is set to _subnet_, otherwise must be empty.
- `tag_rules` (Attributes List) Optional. List of tag rules to match against infrastructure source objects effective tags.  Must be set if _source_ is set to _tag_rule_, otherwise must be empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--sources--tag_rules))

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi--sources--tag_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi.sources.tag_rules`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Required. Tag key to match against a source object's effective tags.
- `op` (String) Optional. Match operator.  Supported values: - EQUALS: matches when the key exists and its value equals the configured value. - NOT_EQUALS: matches when the key exists and all values for that key differ   from the configured value.  A missing key does not satisfy either operator.  Defaults to _EQUALS_.
- `value` (String) Required. Tag value to match against a source object's effective tags.
